description_html:
Give your iPhone a refined and elegant look with our Premium Leather-Finish Slim Case, designed for everyday style and comfort.

The case features a soft leather-texture back panel that provides a smooth, anti-slip grip, along with a metal camera ring for added protection around the lenses. Its slim and lightweight design ensures your phone stays pocket-friendly while offering reliable protection against scratches and daily wear.Perfect for those who prefer a clean, classy, and minimal aesthetic without adding bulk.

Key Features

 

 

 

 

  • ✔️ Premium leather-texture back (soft & comfortable grip)
  • ✔️ Slim & lightweight design
  • ✔️ Metal camera ring for lens protection
  • ✔️ Scratch & fingerprint resistant
  • ✔️ Precise cut-outs for camera & ports
  • ✔️ Easy snap-on installation
  • ✔️ Ideal for daily use

 

Protection Level

 

 

 

 

  • Protects against scratches, minor drops & daily wear
  • Raised camera edge to prevent lens contact with surfaces

Compatibility

 

 

 

 

 

  • Compatible with iPhone models (select model before checkout)
